input.subject: R/010 – 42 Brackenveil Row – second estimate needed (cupboards and doors only)
input.body:
Hi Kellan,

Thank you for the full-kitchen figures for 42 Brackenveil Row, Oakhollow, ZZ1 1ZZ (ref R/010), which have gone to the landlord.

The landlord also asked for a second, alternative estimate: replacement of the cupboards and doors only, keeping the existing appliances, worktops and flooring, which the landlord says are in good condition. Please could you send that estimate, itemised and showing VAT separately as before? If you need to see the kitchen to price it, let us know and we will arrange a visit with the tenant (two dogs at the property, so access must be arranged in advance).

Please note this is a request for an estimate only. No replacement work has been approved yet.

Many thanks,
Donna, Northbridge Lettings

input.subject: R/010 – 42 Brackenveil Row – kitchen cabinets update
input.body:
Dear Elowen,

An update on the kitchen cabinets at 42 Brackenveil Row, Oakhollow, ZZ1 1ZZ (ref R/010). Sorry for the slow progress. The contractor thinks the laminate can't be repaired properly on its own, so the landlord asked for prices for replacement options. We have sent the landlord the first price and are waiting for the second one and for the landlord's decision. No visit is booked yet. Your offered dates have passed, so we will ask for new availability once the work is agreed.

In the meantime, please avoid the sharp edges. If it's safe to do so, cover them with strong tape, and keep the dogs away from them. If anyone is hurt again or the problem gets worse, please tell us straight away.

We will next update you by 29 September.
